dialogues.speaker: Zimnyakov
dialogues.text: Please don't be on time, please don't be on time, please don't be on time. Please, please...

dialogues.speaker: Zimnyakov
dialogues.text: Yes! If the train arrives on time, then I'll have to start work on time, and then I'll have to deal with that absolute nightmare of a matter on time.

dialogues.speaker: Zimnyakov
dialogues.text: Oh, heavens! I don't want to look at that mountain of documents, and I don't want to see those impossible people either. Spare me...

dialogues.speaker: Zimnyakov
dialogues.text: Sigh. I think I’ll go have a drink and calm myself down...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: If the train doesn't arrive on time, then you can...

dialogues.speaker: Zimnyakov
dialogues.text: No, I still can't. Heavens! I know that even if the train doesn't arrive on time, I still have to start work on time, and deal with that absolute nightmare of a matter on time.

dialogues.speaker: Zimnyakov
dialogues.text: But... I just... Oh! I don't want to face it. For anyone's sake, I don't want to start working at all!

dialogues.speaker: Zimnyakov
dialogues.text: But the train will arrive on time! I'll start work on time, and then I'll deal with that absolute nightmare of a matter on time!

dialogues.speaker: Zimnyakov
dialogues.text: Everything will be on time. My life will end right on time too. Everyone's will...

dialogues.speaker: Zimnyakov
dialogues.text: Sorry. I must have gone mad...

dialogues.speaker: Zimnyakov
dialogues.text: Sigh. I think I’ll go have a drink and calm myself down...
